rule: Re-home a session to the one open record its prompt names: at the first prompt on the name alone, at any later prompt only when the operator states intent to work there; always announce it.
operator: "that particular session can be rehomed to that newly informed initiative when the user intentionally mentions it"
chose: Re-home on the operator's stated intent at any prompt. The first prompt keeps D25: naming exactly one open record is enough. A later prompt, or a session that has already worked, moves only when it names exactly one open record other than its home AND an intent word (work, continue, switch, move, resume, focus, pick up, task(s), re-home) comes up to 6 words before the name, in the same sentence and not negated. The hook appends the registration (a `rehome: true` session_started when the session was registered there before) and announces the move along with the way back. The MCP server's pin follows the session's home on every write.
over: Keeping D25's first-prompt-only carrier, where the agent must call sofar_start_session itself; or moving on any mention, which the brief's own "check the other initiatives, like the R3 fix and R4 fixes" shows would misfire.
because: The operator asked that a session already working in one initiative move when they intentionally name another. The intent gate keeps a passing mention from moving it, and the announcement plus the way back keep session-orientation D2's spirit.
